sources.title: Wampler Pedals Triumph Overdrive | AllThePedals
sources.excerpt: The Wampler Triumph is an affordable overdrive pedal from the Collective Series, offering versatile tones inspired by the Digitech Bad Monkey and Boss SD-1 . With a two-position voicing switch, it provides both smooth, classic overdrive and punchier, more open tones. Featuring gain, volume, and a 3-band EQ, the Triumph allows precise tone-shaping for all levels of players, offering a range of sounds, including those similar to a Tube Screamer , Klon, and Bluesbreaker. What Wampler Pedals say about the Triumph Overdrive Wampler’s Collective Series pedals are packed with features for players of all levels. Designed for affordability without compromising on the qualities that epitomize Wampler, every Collective Series pedal allows you to easily dial in rich, fat tones ideal for beginners and professionals alike. Welcome to the Collective. The Triumph is a versatile overdrive based around two of Brian’s all-time favorite overdrives, the Digitech Bad Monkey and the Boss SD-1. In typical Wampler fashion, additional EQ stages have been added that allow a variety of different tones as well as internal circuit changes that add polished glassy overtones. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists were very impressed with the Triumph, with many considering it a favorite. Users praised its versatility, particularly the mid-range control and the "Smooth"/"Punch" toggle, which allows it to emulate various classic overdrive sounds. The overall consensus was that it delivers high-quality, organic drive tones. Read reviews on www.wamplerpedals.com Triumph Overdrive compared to ...
